headline: eBay (EBAY) Stock Sees Modest Fair Value Lift As Analysts Debate GMV And AI
summary: eBay’s updated valuation work now points to a fair value of US$110.76, up from US$107.84, giving you a slightly higher price target anchor for thinking about the stock. That shift aligns with recent analyst commentary that considers stronger GMV signals, the potential impact of AI on the marketplace experience, and a wide range of views on how much upside is already reflected in current pricing. headline: eBay Agrees To Pay Nearly $50 Million To Settle Bizarre Lawsuit After Employees Sent Massachusetts Couple Live Roaches and A Fetal Pig
summary: A Massachusetts couple who ran an e-commerce newsletter started receiving anonymous packages containing live cockroaches, a fetal pig, and death threats, and it took years before the full scope of who orchestrated the campaign against them came to light.

headline: Former eBay executives allegedly sent live spiders and a bloody pig mask to critics. Now it's costing them $56 million
summary: A harassment campaign that left two journalists “paralyzed with fear” ended in a massive settlement. Now they’re offering lessons for anyone considering legal action against a powerful company.

headline: Etsy Completes Sale of Depop
summary: Etsy, Inc. (NYSE: ETSY), which owns and operates the Etsy marketplace, the global destination for unique and creative goods, today announced that it has successfully completed the previously announced sale of Depop, a community-powered fashion resale marketplace, to eBay Inc. headline: eBay Completes Acquisition of Depop
summary: eBay Inc. (Nasdaq: EBAY), a global commerce leader that connects millions of buyers and sellers around the world, today announced that it has completed its acquisition of Depop, a leading consumer-to-consumer (C2C) fashion marketplace with a highly-engaged Gen Z and Millennial customer base.
